recommendations.1_immediate: Close Chrome + Steam = +2984 MB RAM instantly
recommendations.2_visual_effects: sysdm.cpl > Advanced > Performance > Best Performance (~300 MB saved)
recommendations.3_defender_exclusion: Add Apex dirs to Defender exclusions (saves ~370 MB scanning overhead)
recommendations.4_lmstudio_ttl: LM Studio Settings > Model Load > Auto-unload after 5 min idle (saves 4-9 GB)
recommendations.5_startup_disable: Task Manager > Startup tab: disable Steam, Chrome, anything not needed
recommendations.6_pagefile_fixed: Set pagefile to fixed 4-8 GB on NVMe (prevents dynamic growth stutter)
recommendations.7_services_manual: SysMain > Manual, DiagTrack > Disabled, WSearch > Manual (on SSD)
recommendations.8_steam_gpu_accel: Steam Settings > Interface > disable GPU-accelerated rendering
